item.title: ‘The Boy Who Stole Billions?’ Exclusive Clip: Sam Bankman-Fried Discusses His Anhedonia, Or Inability To Feel Pleasure
item.description: Convicted cryptocurrency fraudster Sam Bankman-Fried may be serving a 25-year prison sentence for orchestrating one of the largest financial frauds in American history. However, he still maintains that he did nothing wrong. In an exclusive clip from Prime Video ’s upcoming three-part docuseries, “ The Boy Who Stole Billions? ,” the disgraced FTX founder discusses his experience with anhedonia, a condition characterized by an inability to experience pleasure. It’s a curious admission from a man convicted of stealing billions in customer funds, particularly given his continued refusal to accept responsibility. Continue reading ‘The Boy Who Stole Billions?’ Exclusive Clip: Sam Bankman-Fried Discusses His Anhedonia, Or Inability To Feel Pleasure at The Playlist.
